# F1: Unblock long blocker messages in the task detail modal
<!-- packet-artifact-id:v1 {"uid":"1d2ba7be-13be-497d-ad07-64af95fc9f36","displayId":"F1","title":"Unblock long blocker messages in the task detail modal"} -->
<!-- packet-change:v1 {"schemaVersion":1,"uid":"1d2ba7be-13be-497d-ad07-64af95fc9f36","displayId":"F1","status":"ready"} -->

**Status:** Ready

## Intent
The task detail modal clips the "CURRENT STATE" inline message (worker progress, open-ask question, or cleanup/failure note) whenever it exceeds roughly ten lines, trapping the remainder behind a small embedded scrollbar. Operators therefore miss part of the blocker narrative on exactly the task they need the most detail for. Fix it so long messages read in place.

## Current Behavior
`src/ui/layout/task_details/reply.rs :: full_message()` wraps its markdown payload in `egui::ScrollArea::vertical().max_height(110.0 /* narrow */) .max_height(180.0 /* wide */)`, then shows a "Copy full message" button below it. Callers:
- Worker progress message when `implementation_active`
- Cleanup error when `implementation_complete` and cleanup failed
- Latest open-ask question when the modal is idle and awaiting a user answer
Because that inner area is much shorter than the enclosing modal scroll, messages taller than the cap render only partially and require a second horizontal-thumb micro-scroll to reveal the rest — indistinguishable at a glance from the text being cut off. Meanwhile `paint_failure` in `state.rs` emits the raw error as unbounded markdown under the header "Full blocker report", and `paint_task_failure` on the board card already wraps freely, so the discrepancy is conspicuous and confusing.

## Desired Behavior
Inside the task detail modal, the inline state-detail message renders its full length, wrapping to the modal width and extending the enclosing modal scroll when it is longer than the pane. Short messages keep their existing footprint. There is no second embedded vertical scrollbar for this content and no visible cutoff.

## Scope
- Lift or remove the `max_height` cap on the `full_message` scroll area in `src/ui/layout/task_details/reply.rs` so the message joins the parent modal scroll (equivalent to letting the content size drive the height).
- Retain the "Copy full message" affordance.
- Preserve behaviour for all three caller sites (worker progress, cleanup error, open-ask question) without touching their selection logic.
Out of scope: restructuring `full_message` for the discussion-history view, changes to `paint_failure`, changes to the board-card `paint_task_failure`, changes to modal chrome in `src/ui/overlays.rs`, and any change to the copy-text format.

## Affected Product Areas
- Task detail modal – CURRENT STATE pane (`src/ui/layout/task_details/{reply,state}.rs`)
- Rendering of worker-progress, cleanup-error, and open-ask messages within that pane
Shared infrastructure untouched: `src/ui/overlays.rs` modal scaffold, `src/ui/markdown.rs` renderer, board card painters.

## Requirements
- A blocker-related inline message of arbitrary length (e.g. 40+ wrapped lines) inside the task detail modal must render completely within the page, reachable through the outer modal scroll, without a nested vertical scrollbar dedicated solely to that message.
- A short message (≤ ~5 wrapped lines) must occupy effectively the same vertical space it occupies today; adjacent widgets (buttons, next-step footer, collapsibles) shift smoothly rather than jumping abruptly.
- The existing "Copy full message" control must remain immediately below the message and continue to place the message text on the clipboard.
- Behavioural equivalence across all three `full_message` call sites: worker-progress message while a task is active, cleanup-error message on incomplete worktrees, and open-ask question when the modal is idle waiting on the user.

## Decisions and Assumptions
- Treat the report's phrasing "cuts off" as visual truncation caused by the fixed `max_height` cap, consistent with the observed code path; no alternative root cause (elliptical truncation, buffer overrun) is present.
- Chosen remedy is lifting the cap (effectively letting the content dictate its rendered height inside the outer `ScrollArea`), rather than enlarging the numeric constant: growth scales with message length regardless of future wording changes and avoids arbitrarily tuning the magic number.
- Kept the `max_height` mechanism available if regression tests detect overlap; implementation may prefer `ScrollArea::vertical().auto_shrink([false,false])` without `.max_height` OR simply omit the call.
- No data-model, persistence, or API impact. Backwards compatible.
- Rollout requires no migrations; rollback is a single-file revert.

## Acceptance Criteria
- With a fixture worker-progress message ≥ 40 wrapped lines, the task detail modal exposes the entire message via the outer modal scroll; a nested vertical scrollbar bound solely to `full_message` is absent and no portion of the message is unrecoverable.
- With a ≤ 5-wrapped-line message, the diff in total modal height versus the previous build is ≤ one line's worth of padding and the "YOUR NEXT STEP" section still directly abuts the message block as today.
- Clicking "Copy full message" produces clipboard bytes equal to the underlying message text for each of the three call sites (progress / cleanup error / open-ask).
- `cargo test -p packet-ui` (or equivalent unit suite covering task detail painting) passes and includes a new assertion verifying the absence of the previous `max_height(110.0)/max_height(180.0)` binding or proving rendered pixel height equals content height for a long fixture.
